name: markov
description: Markov-chain transition-probability strategy compiled to a WASM module. Discretizes each bar's return into Down/Flat/Up states, learns a 3x3 transition-count matrix online, and trades the current state's forecast: long when P(next=Up) and short when P(next=Down) clear their thresholds. Opens and closes one position, with close_and_reverse a close also reverses.
